provenance.method: Static reading of state.mjs and v1.schema.json; no evaluator or producer imported or executed. Existing frozen oracle supplied the manually stated pending execution. Full post-states, events, effects and refusals derived from source before trace implementation. Python calculated only canonical JSON SHA-256 identifiers.
provenance.independence: Separate assistant contributor; not independent-person review, authentication, live dispatch or a semantic oracle independent of existing evaluator design.
limits: Pure evaluator inputs are caller assertions, not persisted authority.
Returned effects are inert intents; no worker, provider, check, lease timer or process executed.
Only bounded read-only single-stage assignment/acknowledgment/submission and selected refusals covered.
Wrong artifact digest refers to manifest consistency, not stored artifact bytes.
